description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /gt/_work/src
mkdir -p /gt/_work/upx/fuzzers
cp -a /gt/oss_fuzz_project/fuzzers/. /gt/_work/upx/fuzzers/
git submodule update --init
cd /gt/_work/upx
git apply --ignore-space-change --ignore-whitespace /gt/oss_fuzz_project/fuzzers/build.patch
export CC=clang CXX=clang++
export CFLAGS='-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address'
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"
export LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE='-fsanitize=fuzzer'
export SANITIZER=address FUZZING_ENGINE=afl
rm -rf /gt/_out /gt/_work/upx/build
mkdir -p /gt/_out
cmake -S /gt/_work/upx -B /gt/_work/upx/build/debug
cmake --build /gt/_work/upx/build/debug --target decompress_packed_file_fuzzer -v
cp /gt/_work/upx/build/debug/decompress_packed_file_fuzzer /gt/_out/
